method: Current source inspection and primary HTTP specification; no runtime or private IDM-format analysis
priorFinding: Interrupted whole-resource DASH prefixes required a strong ETag even when a strong modification date could be inferred
newBehavior: Select a strong ETag first; consider dates only when no ETag field exists
Require single complete Last-Modified and Date values and a conservative 60-second separation policy
Persist date strength evidence in protected prefix checkpoints
Use Last-Modified in If-Range and require unchanged validator kind/value before appending
Retain exact URL, range, framing, total-length and prefix/final hash requirements
inference: The 60-second separation is UDM's conservative clock-evidence policy; RFC 9110 permits one second with the stated clock qualification. Arbitrary server skew is not proven safe.
limits: HTTP-date parsing, server/proxy clock, restart, corruption, performance and IDM runtime behavior remain unverified
Tests, installation, installers and publication deferred
